Start here   /   01

Create your first app

Scaffold a workspace, start MongoDB, and make your first authenticated request.

Before you start

Install Node.js 24.16 or newer with npm. Start a local MongoDB service or obtain an Atlas connection string. You need network access for npm dependencies. The shadcn components ship inside the generator.

Create the workspace

Run the wizard. Choose JavaScript or TypeScript for each application. React Compiler, Redux Toolkit, Toastify and the server integrations are optional. Choose automatic installation or run npm install once at the project root.

npx create-modern-mern-app@latest my-app
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev

Try the starter

Open http://localhost:3000. Choose Check API health, then Create an account. Enter a unique email and a password of at least 12 characters. Signup opens the protected dashboard. Sign out and sign back in to check the entire flow.

Configure MongoDB

The generated server/.env contains a unique JWT_SECRET and a local MONGO_URI. Edit this file for Atlas. Keep it out of source control. The backend connects to the database before listening on port 5000.
